milestones.summary: I tuned the Python Kafka consumers behind Instant Bloomberg. Batching messages and changing how we encode and compress them cut message latency by 40% and increased throughput by 25%.
details: The messaging infrastructure supports more than 200,000 daily active mobile users and achieved 99.99% uptime.
Built a service to keep user events in sync with Redis and distributed messaging. Also built audio messaging APIs that support compliance intervention.
Led the migration from physical to virtual clusters to improve deployment and scaling.

milestones.summary: I led iOS development for Cookpad’s recipe-sharing app. In my final year I moved to backend and data engineering, building event pipelines and streaming generated recipes to mobile clients.
details: Mentored four developers on API use and client-server design.
Built cross-platform event ingestion and enrichment with Snowplow, dbt and Redshift.
Used Flask and Server-Sent Events so readers could see each part of a recipe as it arrived.
milestones.stack: Swift · Python · Flask · Snowplow · dbt · Redshift

milestones.summary: I helped design the API gateway and data localization strategy for Farfetch in China. The infrastructure changes reduced API and CDN timeouts by 65%.
I built iOS apps for financial services in China, working within the group’s compliance requirements.
